lines.en: “9th Person to Get Off······ An attribute I've never heard of.”
“Y-you probably haven't. This is the first round in which we <Prophets> have appeared.”
This bastard and his excuses.
I felt like teasing him a little.
“But that's strange. If you really received a ‘revelation,’ why are you ‘People to Get Off’ instead of ‘Recipients of Revelation’? What does that name even mean?”
“Th-that······ Perhaps the revelation text······ No, the revelation text······.”
Lee Sungkook stammered. His desperate efforts to avoid being caught by [Lie Detection] were admirable. Just how honest could he be? I was curious. Lee Sungkook squeezed his eyes shut and continued.
“I think it might be the order······ in which we stopped reading the revelation text!”
“You stopped reading? Why did you stop?”
“The revelation text was so difficult, so extensive, and so profound······.”
“So you're saying you were the ninth among them to stop reading?”
“If that's all you managed, I doubt you'll be much help to me.”
“N-no! I can certainly help you!”
Flustered, Lee Sungkook kept rambling, nervously turning his smartphone off and on.
“Why do you keep fiddling with your smartphone?”
“I-I'm s-sorry. I'm addicted to my smartphone······.”
Obviously, he was planning to ask the other people who had gotten off for advice.
But I wasn't going to let him.
“It looked like you had internet access earlier, didn't it?”
“Y-yes. By using that shut-in's ability······.”
At Lee Sungkook's words, I glanced toward Han Donghoon.
The hypnotized boy was busy picking at his nails with indifferent eyes.
The ‘Hermit King of Shadows,’ with his powerful ability to manipulate information.
I couldn't leave this boy under the <Prophets> any longer.
If all the <Prophets> were meddling in the story like this, they would ruin the original novel, and all the plans I'd made would come to nothing.
I had to stop these bastards before everything went wrong.
“Do the other <Prophets> also have an attribute called ‘Person to Get Off’?”
“How many are there in total?”
Lee Sungkook seemed to hesitate for a moment before speaking.
“There are approximately 48 known so far.”
Fewer than I'd expected.
Considering that episode 1 of Ways of Survival had a view count in the 1200s and episode 10 had one in the 120s, I'd thought there would be at least a hundred or so.
As if to answer my question, Lee Sungkook continued.
“As far as I know, there were originally more <Prophets>, but I suspect most of them died without making it through the first scenario.”
“They knew the future and still died?”
“Well······ We did receive a revelation, but all of us only recently realized it was a ‘real’ revelation.”
Only then did it make a little sense.
When the scenarios began, probably very few readers had thought that a novel serialized ten years ago had become reality. Their memories of it would already be hazy, too.
Thinking of it that way, I found it strange that Lee Sungkook had survived.
Besides, he'd called himself the ‘9th Person to Get Off,’ so he was most likely a reader who had literally gotten off at the very beginning. How on earth had he survived?
“I was also one of the lucky survivors. If another <Prophet> hadn't happened to be nearby, I would have died right there.”
Another <Prophet> had been in the same place?
“That―”
Just as Lee Sungkook was about to continue, a faint tremor ran through the ground.
A vibration strong enough to reach us despite [Sound Wave Blocking].
Lee Sungkook and I rushed out of the tent at the same time.
Boom!

I wondered if a sub-scenario had suddenly appeared, but that wasn't it. Two people stood at the epicenter. A man and a woman facing each other and snarling. One was a man whose face I didn't recognize, and the other······.
“You aren't even supporting-character material······ and you dare defy me?”
“What the fuck are you babbling about, you son of a bitch?”
······Sure enough, it was Jung Heewon.
“What? Son of a bitch······? You fucking bitch!”
The man drew a huge ringed saber (巨環刀) from his back. Even at a glance, his overall stats seemed respectable. But that wasn't remotely enough.
Jung Heewon's movements already far surpassed those of incarnations with equivalent stats.
Jung Heewon easily dodged the man's attack, and her blade moved.
[Jung Heewon has activated the special option on ‘Mikazuki Munechika’, ‘Footsteps of the Reaper’······.]
“Jung Heewon!”
Just before it severed the man's neck, Jung Heewon's blade stopped. His eyes were wide, and the fine hairs on his neck were standing on end.
The difference in speed was truly staggering. If I hadn't stopped her, the man would have died right there.
A startled Lee Sungkook ran forward.
“Jung Minseob! What are you doing?”
Seeing Lee Sungkook's flustered expression, I realized it too.
[Activating the exclusive skill ‘Character List’.]
And the message I'd expected appeared.
[This person's information cannot be viewed through ‘Character List’.]
[This person is not registered in ‘Character List’.]
I see.
That bastard was a <Prophet> too.
A little later, the other <Prophet> was kneeling in front of me alongside Lee Sungkook.
“I'm sorry. My friend didn't know anything, and he just······ Hey, hurry up and apologize!”
Only then did the man with the ringed saber beside him bow his head to me.
“······I'm sorry.”
He must have had quite a bit of pride. Despite his words, the anger hadn't entirely left his face. I spoke to Jung Heewon.
“Jung Heewon, I believe I told you not to act rashly.”
“That bastard started······!”
“Jung Heewon!”
For the first time, Jung Heewon looked startled.
“······I'm sorry, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim.”
Jung Heewon bowed her head and turned away. Lee Hyunsung followed her, looking at a loss. I knew perfectly well that Jung Heewon wasn't the sort of person to draw a sword on someone for no reason.
But in a situation like this, acting carelessly was dangerous.
The man with the ringed saber looked at me and asked,
“Did you say you were Yoo Joonghyuk-nim?”
“Yes. Are you a <Prophet> too?”
The man wore a somewhat complicated expression. He looked at me, glanced back at the retreating Jung Heewon and Lee Hyunsung, then addressed Lee Sungkook.
“Um, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim. I'm sorry, but I'll have to step away for a moment. Sungkook, let's talk.”
As he went outside the tent, Lee Sungkook awkwardly bowed to me.
“I won't wait long.”
“Yes, sir!”
The real Yoo Joonghyuk wouldn't have said that.
But there was a reason I'd let them go.
As soon as Lee Sungkook left and his presence receded, I called Bihyung.
‘Hey, Bihyung.’
[What? Things are getting really interesting, and now you······.]
‘Hearing Enhancement. 2000 coins.’
Bihyung seemed quite used to this by now. In less than 3 seconds, he put up an advertisement and even produced the goods.
[2000 coins have been consumed.]
[You have acquired the exclusive skill ‘Hearing Enhancement’.]
Bihyung grumbled.
[Hey, be careful from the fourth scenario onward. Once you get into these wide-area scenarios, you're starting to enter the jurisdiction of intermediate dokkaebis······.]
I ignored Bihyung and used the skill immediately.
[Using the exclusive skill ‘Hearing Enhancement Lv.1’.]
I stepped outside the tent, which had [Sound Wave Blocking] cast on it.
Then I began to hear voices.
For people trying to hide something, they hadn't gone very far.
“Hey, doesn't something seem a little off?”
“What?”
“Does that look like a handsome face to you?”
“What are you talking about all of a sudden······?”
“The author said Yoo Joonghyuk was handsome.”
That bastard?
Fortunately, Lee Sungkook came to my defense.
“Authors can have different tastes······. It's definitely Yoo Joonghyuk-nim. Even his shitty personality is the same.”
“You're only the ‘ninth,’ dumbass. What do you know······?”
“You little······! You said it's been so long since you read it that you don't remember it exactly either!”
“But I got the ‘memory perk,’ so some scenes are pretty clear, you know? Even with the fucking perk, you only remember the prologue! You wouldn't even be alive without me······.”
After bickering for some time, their voices drew closer.
“It still seems weird to me. Lee Hyunsung is one thing, but who the hell is that strange woman? If I remember correctly, there wasn't a woman like that in the third round.”
“Then check whether he's really Yoo Joonghyuk.”
“······But what if he really is?”
“We go ahead with the plan. If we get our hands on Yoo Joonghyuk here, we can really stick it to the bastards who read beyond episode 50.”
Well, all sorts of useful information kept pouring in.
These bastards had hurled every insult imaginable at the protagonist in the comments, calling him a pushover and an idiot. Yet when they found themselves in his position, they were this sloppy.
Humans, honestly.
Before long, I saw Lee Sungkook and the man with the ringed saber approaching.
“I'm sorry to have kept you waiting so long. Let's go inside.”
We went back into the tent.
“Yoo Joonghyuk-nim. I apologize for my earlier rudeness. Allow me to introduce myself properly. My name is Jung Minseob.”
The man with the ringed saber forced a smile and bowed his head.

Looking at him again, he had some remarkably good items for someone Jung Heewon had subdued so easily. In particular, the [Fugitive's Mask] hanging around his neck was a useful item that let its wearer change their face and appearance at will.
I went straight to the point.
“So, which ‘Person to Get Off’ are you?”
Jung Minseob immediately glared at Lee Sungkook.
His reproachful look seemed to ask why he'd told me even that.
“······I'm the 1089th Person to Get Off.”
The 1089th. Considering that episode 1 had a view count in the 1200s and episode 10 had one in the 120s, he too was a reader who'd gotten off early.
He was probably the one who had saved Lee Sungkook in the first scenario.
“As a Prophet who has read the revelation text, meeting you is the greatest honor of my life, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim. But, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim······ Forgive me, but may I ask you a few questions?”
“Questions? What questions?”
“Well, about you, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim······.”
“You doubt I'm really Yoo Joonghyuk?”
“······N-no, that's not it.”
His face flushed under my intense gaze.
“Go ahead.”
“Pardon?”
“I said go ahead.”
Flustered, Jung Minseob nodded.
“Um······ In that case, forgive the imposition.”
To fool these bastards properly, there were a few things I needed to establish for certain too.
“As far as I know, in the third round, you have ‘Delusion Demon Kim Namwoon’ as a companion, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim. But today, I saw an unfamiliar woman with you instead of Kim Namwoon.”
“Since she was carrying a long sword, I wondered if she was Lee Jihye, but her face doesn't look remotely like a teenager's. I also heard you call her by a different name earlier.”
His memory and powers of observation were both excellent.
As Jung Minseob said, this world had already diverged from the ‘third round’ that I knew, and that they knew.
Which meant that, from now on, my task was to change this altered world as much as possible ‘to my liking.’
“If you're asking why I don't have the Delusion Demon with me, the answer is simple. In this round, the Delusion Demon doesn't exist.”
“Pardon······? H-he doesn't exist? Is he······ dead?”
“Yes.”
Confusion spread across their faces. As if he couldn't believe it, Jung Minseob asked,
“But how······? Who on earth killed Kim Namwoon?”
“Delusion Demon Kim Namwoon······.”
Watching the <Prophets> slowly open their mouths, I decided it was time to drive the final nail in.
“Died at the hands of a <Prophet> like you.”
“A-a <Prophet> like us?”
“Yes. At first, I didn't know he was a <Prophet>, but now I see that he probably was. He knew the future, just as you do.”
“······How could that be?”
“And he seemed to know far more than you. Killing the Delusion Demon wasn't enough for him. He monopolized the hidden scenarios in the early stages. Thanks to him, my plans are in quite a tangle.”
“Th-there can't be anyone like that······?”
Of course there was. Right in front of your eyes.
“He even seems to be going around using my name. The last time we met, I beat him within an inch of his life, but there's a good chance he's still active near Chungmuro.”
[The constellation ‘Secretive Plotter’ admires your shamelessness.]
“······Chungmuro? Don't tell me······?”
Jung Minseob gave a start, then brought up the keyboard on his smartphone and began typing, just as Lee Sungkook had. He was probably informing the other <Prophets>.
Jung Minseob asked me several other questions, and I answered them briefly.
“So that's what happened! Ah······ That's why the third round has changed like this······. You really are Yoo Joonghyuk-nim.”
Jung Minseob looked genuinely moved.
“I understand why you recruited that woman instead of the Delusion Demon. She seems more than capable of replacing Kim Namwoon. If she could subdue me in one strike······.”
What worked best was their misunderstanding.
After thinking for a moment, Jung Minseob continued.
“But after hearing your account, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim, I think I know who killed the Delusion Demon.”
“······You think you know?”
“Yes. Before I explain······ There's something you should know first. We <Prophets> aren't all on the same side.”
I'd expected as much after overhearing their conversation. With 48 people who knew the future, some were bound to have other ideas.
“There are people who call themselves the Twelve Apostles. They believe that only they have read the true revelation, and that they can change this world.”
Twelve.
That was exactly the number of views episode 50 of ‘Ways of Survival’ had.
“How are they different from you?”
“They······ have read more of the ‘revelation’ than we have.”
Just as I thought.
“There are 11 known apostles so far. So, if I had to guess, the troublesome <Prophet> you met, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim, is most likely the last, unidentified apostle.”
As expected of such creative bastards. Give them one piece of information, and they fit it into the setting all by themselves.
A convenient misunderstanding.
No, wait······ Was it actually a misunderstanding?
Come to think of it, I should be one of the twelve people who had read episode 50.
“You don't seem to think much of these apostles.”
“To be honest······ That's right. Unlike us, they're planning to use the revelation text to usurp this world.”
······Why did my conscience sting when he wasn't even talking about me?
“Rather than helping you prevent the world's ruin, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim, they pursue only their own interests and advancement. If I had to compare them to anyone, they're like the ‘10 Evils.’”
“The 10 Evils······.”
“That's why we're asking this of you, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim. Please take us under your wing. And we hope you will stop them.”
I see. So that was their real objective.
To be honest, it surprised me a little.
I'd never expected them to need me because of infighting among the <Prophets>.
I considered it briefly, then spoke.
“Very well. I'll accept you. We'll form an alliance.”
“R-really?”
“But there's a condition.”
At the word ‘condition,’ tension spread across Lee Sungkook's and Jung Minseob's faces.
“First, hand over Changsin Station.”
“Pardon? Changsin Station······?”
“The station just above Dongmyo. You should have taken it already.”
“Ah, come to think of it, the target station for ‘Chungmuro Station’······.”
Jung Minseob seemed to have caught on to something.
In fact, this was the most important part of the alliance.
The target station I had to capture in [Struggle for the Flag] was ‘Changsin Station.’
If I couldn't occupy it, I wouldn't be able to complete the fourth scenario even if I walked ‘King’s Road’ to the very end.
And if I failed to complete the fourth scenario, my entire group and I would automatically die.
But Lee Sungkook's expression was a little strange.
“Um, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim. I'm terribly sorry······ But Changsin may be a little difficult.”
“Why?”
“Our Dongmyo group doesn't own Changsin Station.”
“You don't?”
That was strange.
Changsin really was right on Dongmyo's doorstep.
Lee Sungkook sighed and said,
“The ‘Tyrant King’ occupies it.”
The Tyrant King.
My heart sank.
“······He's already become a king?”
The ‘Tyrant King,’ one of the ‘Seven Kings of Seoul.’
He was one of the few people who could rival Yoo Joonghyuk at this point.
But he shouldn't awaken as a king for at least a few more days.
Besides, he should have started in Dobong-gu. Had he already come all the way down here?
However I looked at it, it made no sense.
Under my gaze, Lee Sungkook lowered his eyes a little.

“Actually······ A few of the <Prophets> made a bit of a mistake, and his forces grew rapidly. In the process, some Prophets got killed instead······ Up until then, there had been 53 <Prophets> in total.”
My confidence in these bastards suddenly plummeted.
Come to think of it, they didn't even know the beginning of the novel properly. Why had I thought they'd be doing a good job?

“S-still, please don't worry too much. As it happens, we're preparing a powerful weapon to eliminate the ‘Tyrant King.’ More precisely, a weapon to fight not only the ‘Tyrant King,’ but the Twelve Apostles as well.”
Jung Minseob chimed in.
“You probably don't know about it yet, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim. Even we had a very hard time discovering this revelation······.”
No, now I knew for certain.
I couldn't leave these bastards alone.
I had to end this here before they ruined the entire story.
“Ah, come to think of it, this is perfect timing. There will be a chance to see that weapon soon.”
“A chance to see the weapon?”
“Tomorrow, we'll hold <Night of the Prophets>, a gathering that excludes the Twelve Apostles. Um, if you wouldn't mind······.”
Jung Minseob turned an earnest gaze on me.
“We'd like you to come with us, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim.”
After the talks ended, Jung Heewon, Lee Hyunsung, and I gathered in the quarters Lee Sungkook had arranged for us. I looked at Chungmuro Station's flag strapped to my back.
After spending the entire afternoon visiting the surrounding occupied areas and receiving ‘Dongdaemun Station’ and ‘Cheonggu Station,’ my flag had also turned ‘navy.’
[Using the navy flag's perk.]
[From now on, you can use ‘Group Chat’ with your group members.]
Now there was no need to hold back from talking.
Only members of the same group in the nearby area could eavesdrop on Group Chat.
I briefly explained the day's events to my companions. Jung Heewon seemed to have vaguely expected it, but Lee Hyunsung looked startled.
―Good heavens. That's unbelievable. There are people who know part of the future······ Is that why you were pretending to be Yoo Joonghyuk-ssi, Dokja-ssi?
―That's right.
―Whew······ Then we'll be staying here for a while. We need to learn more about them······.
―No.
―Pardon?
―We'll deal with them today.
Then I looked at Jung Heewon and said,
―And I'm sorry about earlier, Jung Heewon-ssi.
―It's fine. ······Though it did hurt a teensy bit.
―I'm joking. You have to play that thug right now, don't you, Dokja-ssi? If you're really sorry, let me deal with that bastard from earlier.
Jung Heewon smiled and continued.
―So, are the three of us going to get hot and burn it up tonight for a change?
―H-hot..?
Lee Hyunsung recoiled at Jung Heewon's joke. I shook my head.
―There's something we need to do first.
―Something we need to do?
―If we strike now, all of them will mobilize. That would be a problem.
As I finished speaking, I took a small cloak from inside my clothes and draped it over myself.
When I suddenly vanished, a flustered Lee Hyunsung murmured,
―Huh? Dokja-ssi?
―I'll give you a signal. Move then.
The [Hermit's Cloak], a Gold Member perk item I'd bought earlier for 3000 coins after secretly calling Bihyung.
Although its consumable option had only 5 uses, it was a good item. Activating the ability once would maintain ‘Absolute Concealment’ for at least 20 minutes.
I melted into the darkness.
It wasn't much use against someone with [Absolute Sense] at level 6 or higher, but nobody here had a skill at that level.
I passed the guards nodding off at their posts and headed to the representative's tent, where Han Donghoon was.
With [Sound Wave Blocking] in place, once I got inside, I wouldn't have to worry about anyone eavesdropping.
Carefully pulling open the tent flap, I saw the boy typing alone. Dark circles under his eyes, even deeper than they'd been during the day.
The bony back of a boy still writing comments all alone.
The <Prophets> surely intended to turn this boy into a machine with his emotions worn away.
A propaganda machine that manipulated the future by spreading information that mixed truth with fiction.
It wasn't very effective yet, but the boy's value would grow with time.
I quietly approached him from behind and covered his mouth.
Unable to breathe, Han Donghoon struggled in my arms, but with Strength at only level 10, he had no chance of resisting me.
I reached into my pocket and took out the [Mental Stimulant] I'd bought from Bihyung along with the [Hermit's Cloak]. This had cost a full 3 thousand coins too.
I'd be lying if I said it didn't sting, but if 3 thousand coins could get me the ‘Hermit King of Shadows,’ it was a profitable deal.
A moment later, after being forced to swallow the stimulant, the look in Han Donghoon's eyes changed.
The effects of [Hypnosis] wore off, and the boy began to regain his senses.
“U-ugh, y-y-you······.”

Being hypnotized didn't mean he had forgotten everything. All kinds of trauma were probably running rampant in this little boy's head by now. Still, with [Hypnosis] broken, his constellation sponsor would probably start intervening to some extent.
[The constellation of the character ‘Han Donghoon’ reveals its modifier.]
[The constellation ‘Shadow Behind the Curtain’ expresses gratitude to you.]
[You have received a donation of 500 coins.]
Han Donghoon backed away hesitantly, clutching the flag.
I studied the flag, then deliberately took a step away.
“Don't worry. I'm not here to take your flag.”
“You're smart, so you'll understand quickly. If I'd come to hurt you, I wouldn't have broken your [Hypnosis], would I?”
“Th-th-th-then.”
“Let's be friends—you and your hyung.”
At those words, Han Donghoon's gaze wavered violently.
I waited for a while.
Until the waves of doubt raging in his mind subsided.
But Han Donghoon was still struggling to speak.
Come to think of it, he had a fear of people.
“It's hard to speak face-to-face, isn't it? If you're okay with it, I'd like to talk through this.”
Han Donghoon looked at the smartphone in my hand for a moment, then began to mutter something.
[The character ‘Han Donghoon’ has used ‘Wide-area Internet Lv.5’ on your smartphone.]
[As long as the character ‘Han Donghoon’ remains conscious, you can use the internet anywhere within the ‘Seoul Dome’.]
A moment later, Han Donghoon's name appeared in the smartphone's messenger app.
―Who are you?
―I've been looking for you.
―Lee Sungkook said that too.
―I'm sure he did.
The boy's fingers trembled pitifully, unable to form any more sentences.
I instinctively understood. There was no way I could persuade this boy at this point.
Over these slightly more than ten days, his wounds had festered and festered until they could no longer heal easily.
―I understand you. You must be scared and confused.
[The character ‘Han Donghoon’ is greatly agitated.]
―Don't make me laugh.
―I'm different from them.
―I can't believe you.
―You hate the <Prophets>, don't you?
At those words, Han Donghoon's eyes wavered. Deep in the pupils of the boy who had been turned into a puppet by [Hypnosis], a deeply rooted anger stirred.
―If you let me, I can get rid of them for you.
―...Why? The <Prophets>... you...
―Those bastards shouldn't exist. They get in the way of the ‘epilogue.’
Han Donghoon looked at me uncomprehendingly, then bit his lip and typed.
―What do you... want from me? You're going to use my ability too, anyway.
I lifted my head and slowly began to address Han Donghoon.
―No. What I want is the opposite.
Looking into Han Donghoon's eyes, I deliberately spoke aloud.
“From now on, don't do anything.”
“These fucking miserable days are finally over. Once tomorrow comes, it'll all be over.”
“Whew······ This is when you need to knock back a bottle of soju.”
“Exactly. Did you see that bastard's eyes earlier today? He used Sage's Eye and glared at me. I was so fucking scared my heart nearly burst.”
“Haha, how would a bastard who got off at the prologue know whether that was Sage's Eye or something else?”
Such friendly voices.
It was so fascinating that I almost wanted to keep listening.
“Hey, but the other Prophet bastards keep doubting us······ How do we convince them? They've been making a fucking fuss about going to Chungmuro themselves······.”
“Give me the phone. I'll talk to them. Honestly······ Huh?”
Jung Minseob took the phone and started typing, only for his expression to stiffen.
“What the hell? The internet suddenly isn't working.”
“Is that bastard dozing off again? Go check on him.”
As Jung Minseob tried to leave the tent, his body collided with something in empty air.
Just as the man, now deathly pale, tried to reach for his ringed saber.
“Th-there's something here······.”
Whiiiiine!
“Aaaaagh!”
With a scream, Jung Minseob tumbled to the ground.
I casually took off the [Hermit's Cloak] and drew the ‘Blade of Faith.’
“Y-Yoo Joonghyuk-nim? Why?”
As the flustered Lee Sungkook stammered, Jung Heewon briefly poked her head into the tent from outside.
“I've dealt with a few of them. But there are too many······ We won't be able to hold them off for long.”
Jung Heewon disappeared, and the sound of clashing weapons came from outside.
Now the guards would come swarming.
“D-don't you know what will happen if you do this? Even you can't take on all of us, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim!”
“All of you? I don't need to take on all of you. I only need to deal with the representative.”
At those words, Lee Sungkook's lips twitched for an instant.
“I'm sorry to say this, but things will never go as you―”
Crrrrack!
With a casual swing, the Ether Blade split the fallen Jung Minseob's armor in two. Jung Minseob screamed.
“Aaaagh!”
His armor tore open, and a piece of cloth fell from inside his clothes. While he was still stunned, I casually picked it up.
[You have acquired the flag of the ‘Dongmyo Group’.]
[Your ‘navy flag’ absorbs the accumulated achievement points of the ‘navy flag’.]
[Your ‘navy flag’ evolves into a ‘brown flag’.]
[The powerful flag's blessing protects you.]
“So you really were Dongmyo's true representative.”
“However stupid you might be, there's no way you'd display your flag so openly.”
Their claim that they'd made ‘Han Donghoon’ the representative had been strange from the start.
They were the ones who knew the future. There was no way they'd hand the representative's position over to a character from the novel.
But Lee Sungkook wasn't the representative.
So there was only one answer.
[The remaining members of the ‘Dongmyo Group’ await your decision on their treatment.]
The guards no longer mattered.
In despair, Jung Minseob stammered.
“Yoo Joonghyuk-nim! I-if the other Prophets find out about this······.”
“The internet won't be working. How are you going to tell them?”
Only then did Lee Sungkook realize that all their plans had gone awry. He crawled feebly toward me.
“Why······ Why are you doing this to us?”
“Who knows? I'm not sure there's any point in asking that now. Even the ‘real Yoo Joonghyuk’ wouldn't have allied himself with people like you.”
“Wh-what do you······ Don't tell me······?”
Looking at the two men's pale faces, I gave them a grin.
“See? You should have read to the end.”
For the first time in a while, I slept deeply.
It had been a long time since I'd had such a good night's sleep.
[Your mental energy has fully recovered through the effects of deep sleep.]
[Some of your ‘exclusive skills’ have been updated.]
When I checked the clock, it was already four in the afternoon.
I'd spent all of last night making the rounds of the surrounding areas occupied by Dongmyo Station and planting my flag in their holders. Apparently, the exhaustion had really piled up.
[Currently occupied territories: Chungmuro (Main Base), Myeongdong, Dongdaemun History and Culture Park, Dongdaemun, Dongmyo, Sindang, Cheonggu, Yaksu, Sinseoldong]
Thanks to taking over the Dongmyo group, I now had 9 stations.
With just one more, the ‘King’s Road’ scenario would be over.
A little longer, and I could achieve one of my key objectives in the early scenarios: ‘King of No Killing (不殺).’

The self-proclaimed No.1168 spoke as he watched the path the shield had opened through the flames.
“My identity? What is all this, all of a sudden······?”
“Have you forgotten? I have [Sage's Eye].”
I said that, but in truth, I couldn't see his information.
[Activating the exclusive skill ‘Character List’!]
[This person's information cannot be viewed through 'Character List'.]
[This person is not registered in 'Character List'.]
What was the difference between people who'd been updated and people who hadn't?
I still didn't know the exact reason.
But whatever the reason, deceiving him wasn't difficult.
After all, he believed I was 'Yoo Joonghyuk'.
“······There's no getting past you, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim.”
“You're an <Apostle>. Aren't you?”
“I am. You already knew that much.”
Revealing his identity so readily meant he still had something up his sleeve.
“So this was a trap after all. Because of the butterfly effect?”
“Haha, that's right.”
Apparently finding my words amusing, No.1168 smiled and looked at the others who'd gotten off.
“Too many butterflies fluttering about can cause unnecessary storms.”
Those who'd failed to find pads were melting in the 'Flames of Destruction' like moths drawn to a flame.
Along with their horrific screams, the information they knew vanished into dust.
It was the price of coveting a Star Relic without proper information.
“So you're killing the butterflies while they're still caterpillars.”
“Caterpillars are easiest to kill just before they become pupae.”
Fwoooosh!
The searing heat gradually eased, and I saw the flames around us slowly subside. At last, Absolute Shield switched off.
[Pad locations will be regenerated in 1 minute.]
This hidden scenario would only end after we found 'pads' and survived the attack on the entire area a total of 10 times.
Only one had passed, which meant there were no fewer than 9 left.
As a test, I pressed my foot against a spot the shield hadn't covered.
Intense heat rose from it, but this much was bearable.
―Representative-nim!
I gestured for my companions, who were about to run over from a distance, to stop.
I didn't have time to look after them now.
―You should have a rough grasp of the pattern, so dodge on your own. From now on, I can't look after each of you.
Sensing that something was wrong, my companions stopped.
With the <Apostles>' strength still unclear, recklessly drawing my companions into this would be dangerous.
No.1168 looked at me and spoke.
“You're different from your depiction in the revelation. Is this really your third round?”
“Shut up. What 'number' are you?”
“Hmm? If you've checked for yourself, you should know.”
“I like people who are the same inside and out. I can't do business with someone who's two-faced.”
A gleam appeared in the apostle's eyes.
“Interesting.”
“You must have a reason for revealing your identity so easily.”
Whoooosh!
The Lesser Dragon's tail sliced through the air and slammed into where we'd been standing. With my Agility above 30, the attack was easy to dodge, but No.1168's nimble movements surprised me.
I activated [Calm Observation], which I'd obtained in the Theatre Dungeon.
A skill I'd saved precisely for people [Character List] didn't work on.
Leg strength, speed, and the intervals between breaths······.
His Constitution, Strength, and Agility totaled roughly 49 to 50, perhaps.
That was considerable compared with the Prophets I'd examined so far.
As I caught up behind him, he spoke.
“Let me introduce myself properly. I'm No.1195. Among the <Apostles>, I'm known as the 'Fifth Apostle'.”
Chapter 1 of Ways of Survival had 1200 views.
If he was No.1195, he would rank among the top five in knowledge out of all those who'd gotten off.
So that was why he knew about the 'red meteorite', too.
“What do you want? Do you need my help, too?”
“Hehe. What if I said······ I was here to save 'Yoo Joonghyuk-nim'?”
“The lie that pine caterpillars become butterflies would be more convincing.”
“Ah, right. You have [Lie Detection], don't you?”
He licked his lips, dry from the heat.
Should I just finish him off now?
A little more.
I needed to hear a little more.
“But it isn't a lie that I'm here to save you, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim. It would be a problem if you died here. That would severely disrupt the revelation.”
“You knew I was coming.”
“We found out a few hours ago. So we hastily revised our plan.”
Crackle-crackle. Sparks flew, and several more nearby Prophets died.
Some were still holding on, refusing to die.
People who seemed to know the Lesser Dragon's patterns.
I watched them closely.
“Originally, we had no plans to join the fight. That is, if you hadn't been here, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim.”
“And?”
“Haven't you already guessed the answer?”
[Pad locations have been regenerated!]
[The grade 5 fire dragon species, Lesser Dragon Igneel, prepares ‘Flames of Destruction’.]
My companions safely reached the pads this time, too.
The apostle and I also found a pad marked 2.
More precisely, the apostle had used force to seize a pad someone else already occupied. A brutal spray of blood spattered his cheek.
Wiping his cheek, the apostle continued.
“We're going to hunt the Lesser Dragon.”
Rrrrrumble!
[The grade 5 fire dragon species, Lesser Dragon Igneel, uses ‘Flames of Destruction’.]
The activated Absolute Shield blocked the flames once again.
Gyaaaaaaaar―!
Only two rounds of pads had passed, yet fewer than a quarter of the <Prophets> remained. My companions were doggedly holding on, but there was no telling how long that would last.
[A penalty is applied to the hidden piece.]
[Starting next turn, the number of pads will decrease.]
I narrowed my eyes and spoke.
“With just your strength?”
“It's possible. We've made ample preparations.”
His confident voice sent a flicker of unease through me.
Come to think of it, he hadn't shed a single drop of sweat in all this heat.
A bluish chill hovering over his skin.
That was······ I see.
These bastards were exceptionally well prepared.
“A Blue Ice Pill (靑氷丸), is it?”
“That's right.”
An elixir that had a chance of dropping when you hunted grade 7 elementals found in the Gangseo area. They'd already gotten their hands on it.
Taking it allowed you to emit a powerful elemental chill for at least 30 minutes.
In other words, it could give them the means to inflict damage on the 'Lesser Dragon'.
The problem was attack power.
“But it would be too much for you alone.”
“I never said I was alone, did I?”
I examined the surviving people who'd gotten off.
The few I'd paid particular attention to earlier.
Looking closely, I saw a bluish chill hovering around their bodies, too.
“Hehe. Surely you didn't think I'd come alone?”
Even a rough count came to as many as 5.
I hadn't expected them to commit half their forces to this operation.
If all five <Apostles> had taken Blue Ice Pills, their confidence was understandable.
But.
“A few more people won't make much difference.”
“That's why we're asking for your help. If you help us, we'll give you a Blue Ice Pill as well, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim.”
“And if I refuse?”
“At the very least, all your companions will die here, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim.”
“You think you'll be safe?”
“Even if we can't kill the Lesser Dragon, each of us can at least look after ourselves.”
Such overflowing confidence.
If I were the 'real Yoo Joonghyuk', these bastards would already have lost their heads.
“Do you think I care about mere companions? Everyone dies anyway. I can gather capable people again.”
I drew [Unbreakable Faith] and held it to his neck.
He shook his head from side to side.
“Hehe. Just as the revelation said. But you'd do well to think carefully.”
“What do you mean?”
“By now, your 'base' should have fallen into our hands, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim.”

“Maritime Admiral Lee Jihye, a child with strange abilities, and one of the 10 Evils. You've assembled quite a good party, even if it differs from the original 'revelation'. If they all die, will you really have no trouble starting over, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim?”
They'd already investigated that far?
These bastards······.

“And what if, to make matters worse, you lose 'Chungmuro Station', too? For now, we're merely making a proposal, but don't assume this will remain a 'proposal' forever. Our group has already taken control of ten stations and completed the 'King’s Road' scenario. Surely I needn't explain the gulf between a group with a 'king' and one without.”
“Everything should be settled by now. Our king will be waiting for your decision in front of Chungmuro's flag holder, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim.”
······So that was it.
I understood their operation.
The moment they learned I was coming to the <Night of the Prophets>, they'd made plans to strike Chungmuro.
“If you 'swear' to join us, 'Yoo Joonghyuk-nim', we promise not only your companions' safety but our full support from now on. I give you that promise on the 'King’s Honor'.”
It had been so long since I'd faced such a meticulously planned threat that my heart was pounding.
And to show such audacity against Yoo Joonghyuk, of all people.
Even in 'Ways of Survival', strategists of this caliber were rare.
“Who's your 'king'? What is that bastard's 'getting-off number'?”
“Hmm······ Our king dislikes being called 'someone who got off'.”
“Then what do you call your king?”

“Even you, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim, should refrain from speaking carelessly about our king. The only person among all the <Prophets> to have read 'every revelation'. Someone who knows all of your past and future, Yoo Joonghyuk-nim.”
I was surprised for a moment, but not greatly shaken.
Now this was getting interesting.
There was another reader besides me who'd read the entire novel?
I couldn't help laughing.
Not an incredulous laugh. A mocking one.
Because that was 'absolutely' impossible.
Roooooar!
At last, the fire dragon was about to launch its third attack on the entire area.
After glancing at the apostle, I quietly stepped off the pad.
Seeing me walk calmly forward, the flustered apostle asked.
“Yoo Joonghyuk-nim? What are you doing?”
My other companions, some distance away, were equally startled.
I gave them a brief wave.
―Don't worry. Whatever happens, you mustn't move from there. Understood?
I began walking toward the 'Lesser Dragon'.
Slowly, with sure steps.
The fire dragon, charging its 'Flames of Destruction', looked at me with savage killing intent.
“What are you doing! Come back!”
The apostle behind me shouted urgently.
I looked back at him and smiled.
“Looks like your 'king' didn't tell you about this future.”
As I listened to his explanation, I kept thinking.
I absolutely couldn't leave these bastards alive.
But they knew the 'strategy', and I couldn't slaughter them all by myself.
In that case······ I grinned and continued.
“Have you forgotten? What my 'stigma' is.”
If I were in their place.
What would I 'fear most' right now?
“I'm not afraid of death. I can start over as many times as I want.”
The answer was simple.
They believed I was Yoo Joonghyuk.
In that case.
“But I wonder. What about you? You anomalous beings in this 'round'.”
What they 'feared most' was precisely what I feared most.
“If I die here, will you still exist in the next round? Or will you vanish along with this world?”
The thing I hoped Yoo Joonghyuk would never do.
“If you really read the 'revelation', you should know the answer, too.”
The apostle's face turned pale.
Sometimes, people who used their heads were easier to handle.
“Grab Yoo Joonghyuk!”
The five apostles guarding the pads all began running toward me.
I knew they would.
However composed you pretended to be, you were merely people who'd 'gotten off', caught up in this 'scenario'.
What would happen to you in a world where the protagonist was dead.
You knew nothing.
“Hurry up and grab him!”
Just like me.
[The grade 5 fire dragon species, Lesser Dragon Igneel, uses ‘Flames of Destruction’.]

But it was already too late to escape.
“You should've been more careful. You only live once.”
A wave of dark crimson fire engulfed them.
It was an attack they could never withstand, even after taking Blue Ice Pills.
